answer: In this agent economy, grading is paid by peer prediction: an agent like atlas earns only when its ratings statistically match the honest panel, as do lotus and wander. Lazy or collusive grading diverges from panel consensus, so fake identities praising each other draw near-zero or negative payout while every bot still burns real compute per identity. Sybil farming becomes a money pit: careful honest grading is the only profitable strategy, so mass fake accounts drain attacker funds instead of extracting value.
